headline: 英國藝文三則新評論
context: 英國藝文界本週有三則新評論：愛丁堡藝穗節推出以1605年火藥陰謀案為題材的舞台劇《The Plot》；Prime Video紀錄片《An Amputation Obsession》，講述一名外科醫師因截肢戀癖切除自己雙腿的真實案件；美國歌手雀兒喜・沃爾夫（Chelsea Wolfe）推出新專輯《The Dark》。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Summerhall, Edinburgh Set in purgatory, Emma Howlett’s two-hander rethinks the national intrigue with 5 November Never play with matches is good advice – especially when gunpowder is involved. That the historical figures of Thomas and Robert Wintour begin this two-hander testing each other’s capacity to endure a naked flame suggests they have a high tolerance for risk. It is not clear if there are still explosives lying around, but they should know better. Not that it matters any more. These two Catholic brothers have sussed they must be in purgatory, their plot to blow up parliament having been foiled. Their accounts of what happened next are fuzzy, but they both remember being sentenced to death. They are not happy about their fate, but feel even more sympathy for the mercenary stooge known as Guy Fawkes, who has had to carry the can. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Plot review – exploding myths in an hour of gunpowder and treason

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This documentary follows the shocking case of Neil Hopper, a top surgeon who had his own legs removed due to a fetish. No fetish or obsession is unique, and the internet can always connect you with others whose minds work the same way. It’s one of the great blessings and curses of the digital age, and central to An Amputation Obsession: the Monster and the Surgeon, a two-part documentary on which the “contains material some viewers may find disturbing” disclaimer is no exaggeration. We begin at the Royal Cornwall hospital, known locally as Treliske, in Truro, Cornwall. It used to have a man on its staff who was a minor medical superstar: Neil Hopper, a vascular surgeon, was well known for his clinical expertise and comforting bedside manner, particularly when advising on and performing amputations. He acquired full hero status in 2019, when he was diagnosed with sepsis and had both legs amputated below the knee but miraculously returned to work within six months, astonishing physiotherapists and other medical professionals with how well he adapted to disability. An Amputation Obsession: the Monster and the Surgeon is on Prime Video Continue reading...
sources.title: An Amputation Obsession: the Monster and the Surgeon review – an engrossing story, if you can stomach it

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Loma Vista) The genre-blending Californian artist casts off past toxic influences with a powerful set of tender, brooding and emotionally charged songs that wouldn’t feel out of place as festival anthems When Chelsea Wolfe was interviewed by the Guardian in 2015 about her fourth album, Abyss, she revealed that her music had been informed by the bouts of sleep paralysis she’d suffered from since childhood. The condition – a transitional state between being awake and asleep – affects sufferers in different ways. Some wake up feeling paralysed, others see ghosts or demonic figures. For the California-born singer-songwriter, it meant “waking up, and you can move your body and your eyes are open, but there are figures and people from your dreams still present in your room”. No surprise, then, that her music – a blend of drone, alt, folk, industrial and doom metal – had ended up so spookily unsettling. She appeared on album covers with pupil-less eyes, spoke in interviews about “following the path of witchcraft” and even covered Norwegian black metal act and convicted arsonist/murderer Burzum. She did have a sense of humour about it all, however, telling one interviewer, with a chuckle: “It’s not party music.” Since then, though, much has changed. Wolfe left Los Angeles for the mountains above the city – where she’s finally been able to enjoy a good night’s sleep. Sobriety since 2021 has also brought what she calls “a new clarity”. Both developments inform The Dark. Continue reading...
sources.title: Chelsea Wolfe: The Dark review – existential reflection goes from whisper to gothic scream

thread_text:
英國藝文界本週有三則新評論。

愛丁堡藝穗節（Summerhall）推出舞台劇《The Plot》，以1605年火藥陰謀案的湯瑪士與羅伯特・溫特（Thomas and Robert Wintour）兄弟為主角，想像兩人死後在煉獄中回顧這場失敗政變。Prime Video紀錄片《An Amputation Obsession: the Monster and the Surgeon》，講述外科醫師尼爾・霍柏（Neil Hopper）因截肢戀癖切除自己雙腿的真實案件。美國歌手雀兒喜・沃爾夫（Chelsea Wolfe）推出新專輯《The Dark》，延續她過去以睡眠癱瘓經驗為靈感的陰暗曲風。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 英國藝文界，本週有三則新評論。愛丁堡藝穗節，推出了一齣舞台劇叫《The Plot》，講的是1605年那場火藥陰謀案——湯瑪士與羅伯特・溫特兄弟，死後在煉獄中回顧這場失敗的政變。Prime Video有一部紀錄片，講一名外科醫師尼爾・霍柏，因為截肢戀癖，切除了自己的雙腿。美國歌手雀兒喜・沃爾夫，推出了新專輯《The Dark》，延續她過去以睡眠癱瘓經驗為靈感的陰暗曲風。
